summary: Abridge Early Career and NVIDIA China 2027 AI Infrastructure are added as strong, currently actionable matches. OpenAI remains rank 1 but Gmail still has no submission confirmation, so the candidate portal must be checked before any resubmission. Five Rings LINK is removed as a one-week sophomore workshop, Roblox Foundation AI is vetoed for its future-H-1B warning, and newly surfaced Apple Shanghai roles are rejected for 5-6+ years requirements.
